pages.text: The $(item)Wild Skyseed$() — planks and dirt, both off your $(bold)starter island$(). The first seed you can make, and the one to reach for whenever you just want to see what's out there.
Everything's in hand — here's how it goes together.

A Wild Skyseed $(bold)becomes the land it lands on$(): sand and cactus over a desert, bare stone over the mountains, snow over a snowfield, trees over a forest. It grows the very island that biome's own dedicated seed would — no two throws quite alike.

$(bold)A lucky find$()$(br)Every so often — about $(bold)1 in 20$() — a ruin or building rises with the island, loot and all. Unlike the $(item)Explore Skyseed$(), which $(bold)always$() raises one, here it's a surprise. Throw a handful and see what the land gives you.
